serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Landlord.Face.Normal
Landlord: I don’t know how you did it, but guess what. That old bag of bones left for good! Hahahaha!
#Landlord.Face.Surprised
Landlord: Unfortunately, for some reason the corridor is full of bullet holes! You wouldn’t know anything about it, wouldn’t you?!
You: O-Of course not! Hahaha…
I completely forgot about that…
#Landlord.Face.Unhappy
Landlord: Whatever. I don’t go back on my word. No more missions for you. We will go to that stupid island.
You: Stupid island? What do you mean? Wasn’t it your idea to go there? 
Landlord: I lost my motivation.
You: What do you mean? What happened? 
Landlord: I bet you would only laugh at me if you knew…
Well, that is a possibility.
You: Come on. I did all those stupid missions. I deserve to know that much.
You: I noticed that you started acting strange and were stalling on time. What was that about?
Landlord: Fine! I will tell you…
Landlord: You see, I wanted to go to the island, that’s true, but I didn’t want  to go alone.
You: You are going with us though.
Landlord: {{punch}}Who cares about you two?! I wanted to take my daughter with me!
Landlord: Before you gave me the money I wanted to share the good news with my daughter. I wanted to give her a call, but before that I got hungry and went to the shop for some beef jerky and beans.
Landlord: On my way there I saw her. {{wi}}My daughter.
Landlord: I was extremely happy, but she was with friends and I didn’t want to disturb her so I bought the food and went home. 
Landlord: After eating some of the jerky soaked in bean sauce I called her to invite her over, but she said that she was out of town…
Yikes…
Landlord: It was such a shock to me that I didn’t know what to say. Why would she lie like that? We haven't seen each other for almost a year now.
Landlord: That’s when doubt started to creep in. Does she really love me?
Landlord: I-I know it’s a stupid thing to even consider! That’s my Little Angel we are talking about! My honey! 
Landlord: But still… {{wi}}I don’t know how I feel about it…
Landlord: I know that I said that there will be no more missions, but perhaps if you could go and talk to her… {{wi}}Maybe it would ease my doubts. 
You: Ok, I get it. I will do it. 
I feel kinda bad for him… 
#Landlord.Face.Grin
Landlord: I knew that I could count on you! Buahahaha! 
You: …
A great way to make me regret it immediately. 
Landlord: Here’s the picture of her. She should be pretty easy to spot.
You: No kidding. That’s your daughter?
#Landlord.Face.Surprised
Landlord: And what was that supposed to mean?!
You: Nothing. Nothing. I will get right to it.
Landlord: I hope so!
